limitations: Curated internal set authored with explicit gold annotations; not a blind external or third-party human benchmark.
The live set does not exercise SAME transitions; that label is evaluated in the gold-input policy suite.
Only 20 or 60 questions; results have substantial sampling uncertainty and are not general-performance claims.
All methods share the same live extractor and LLM reader. The full-context baseline receives raw user turns.
Vector and graph methods do not receive reconciliation states; hybrid does. Graph uses personalized PageRank.
Retrieval uses K=3; the legacy recall_at_5 field is retained for UI compatibility and must be labeled Recall@3 for this suite.
Latency includes model inference and embedding-cache reads. Cache-hit counts are reported; cached calls are not cold inference measurements.
Answer values are normalized exact matches with declared gold aliases. No unreported model judge is used.
Model errors count as incorrect answers. Negative/cancellation evidence remains auditable.
